exactScopeAndRemainingLimits.scope: Browser source-side organizational ownership and selected-side evidence review in the existing acceptance catalog.
limits: No global shell redesign or full competition product acceptance is covered by this verdict.
The provided screenshots cover desktop dark and 390px mobile dark/light; desktop light, other mobile widths, zoom and assistive-technology runtime behavior were not captured in this packet.

Labels, native controls, status/error announcements, error focus, visible-focus CSS, image alt text and responsive rules were inspected in source. Independent keyboard navigation and numeric WCAG contrast measurement were not performed.
Controlled local fixtures and fresh real engine workers are the current evidence level; this review does not prove arbitrary-site compatibility or deployment immutability.
Browser approval, selection and execution are intentionally unavailable and are not approved by this ship verdict.
